## CEO overview

What is changing: Firstmate will stop telling the captain that a secondmate is stuck when its only overdue items are scheduled reminders for work deliberately waiting on something outside the system.
Why it matters: A secondmate that is busy validating other work can accumulate these reminders and make Firstmate send repeated false alarms even though nothing is stuck.
Customer or business impact: The captain sees fewer false alerts while genuinely stuck work and questions waiting for the captain still produce an alert.
Risk and rollout: Low.
  Only the exact reminder for a declared outside wait is treated as parked, every reminder remains stored for the secondmate, and the parent continues to observe the secondmate's records without changing them.
  Synchronize this narrative into the live pull request description while preserving its machine-owned `## Pipeline` section, then merge only after every hosted check passes under the standing authorization.

## What changed technically

- Changed the parent watcher to select the oldest valid non-parked row from each local secondmate wake queue instead of treating every valid row as proof of a stalled wake loop.
- Limited parked classification to the existing durable message for a declared external-wait pause recheck.
- Kept genuine wedge rows and captain-held decision rows eligible even when parked reminders appear before them.
- Added executable regression coverage for four accumulated parked reminders, a genuine wedge behind them, a captain-held decision behind them, and byte-for-byte preservation of the foreign queue.
- Documented the non-parked queue boundary and its configuration.

## Module-boundary decision

Module-boundary decision: Current module retained.
  Parked-row filtering belongs in the parent observer in `bin/fm-watch.sh`, where wake-loop stall eligibility is decided, rather than in the secondmate producer or queue consumer that must retain and eventually handle the reminder.
  This keeps the change separate from dead-worker pause supervision and preserves the foreign queue's existing read-only ownership boundary.

## Decision needed

Decision needed: No decision required.
  The requested safety boundary is covered, and the outer no-mistakes run can merge under the standing authorization only after the final head is green.
